extracted.intended_audience: UK residential consumers shopping for Sky TV, broadband, and mobile packages
extracted.subtask_description: Terms, requirements, and product/feature conditions for Sky TV, Sky Glass/Stream devices, broadband and add‑ons (UK residential customers). Covers device delivery, streaming requirements, subscription/price/minimum term rules, guarantees, and add‑on conditions.

rubrics_metrics.name: HBO Max access and requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Access to HBO Max Basic with Ads is included with Sky Ultimate TV and allows you to watch on two screens in HD. You can upgrade to HBO Max Standard or HBO Max Premium via Sky Marketplace, further terms apply.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: HBO Max is streamed over broadband; a minimum download speed of 5 Mbps is recommended for HBO Max Basic with Ads and HBO Max Standard and 50 Mbps for HBO Max Premium. To access HBO Max, you will need to have or create an HBO Max account and agree to HBO Max’s terms of use and privacy policy. If you currently pay for HBO Max, taking this service via Sky may result in two HBO Max subscriptions—manage existing subscription before activating via Sky.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disney+ access and requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Access to Disney+ Standard with Ads is included in Sky Ultimate TV and Sky Cinema subscriptions and allows you to watch on two screens in HD. You can upgrade to Disney+ Standard or Disney+ Premium via Sky Marketplace, further terms apply.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Disney+ is streamed over broadband; a minimum download speed of 5 Mbps is recommended for Disney+ Standard with Ads and Disney+ Standard and 25 Mbps for Disney+ Premium. To access Disney+, you will need to have or create a Disney+ account and agree to Disney’s terms of use and privacy policy. If you currently pay for Disney+, activating via Sky may result in duplicate subscriptions—cancel existing subscription if you do not want two.

rubrics_metrics.name: Netflix inclusion and streaming requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Netflix Standard with Ads is included in Sky Essential TV and Ultimate TV subscriptions and allows you to watch on two screens in HD. Upgrade options (Standard, Premium) available as add‑ons with different screen counts and resolutions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Netflix is streamed via broadband; minimum download speed per stream of 3 Mb/s for Netflix Standard with Ads (HD content), 5 Mb/s for Netflix Standard (HD content), and 25 Mb/s for Netflix Premium (Ultra HD content) is recommended. For pre-existing Netflix customers taking Sky subscriptions: your Netflix bill will automatically transfer from Netflix to Sky; if you cancel Streaming TV, billing will transfer back to Netflix.

rubrics_metrics.name: Duplicate third‑party subscription risk and management
rubrics_metrics.description: If you already pay for a third‑party service (HBO Max, Disney+, discovery+, Paramount+, etc.), taking the same service via Sky may result in two subscriptions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To avoid duplicate subscriptions, manage or cancel your existing subscription with the current provider before activating the service through Sky. Separate accounts and terms of the third party still apply.

rubrics_metrics.name: Single Sky TV subscription per address
rubrics_metrics.description: You can only have one Sky TV subscription at your address.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you already have Sky Q or Sky+ you will need to end your current Sky TV subscription and take a new Sky Ultimate TV subscription to move to Streaming TV. Existing minimum terms for add‑ons may require agreeing to new minimum terms for equivalent add‑ons on Streaming TV.

rubrics_metrics.name: Migration rules for existing Sky TV customers
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules that apply when existing Sky TV customers move to Streaming TV.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Billing for existing Sky TV subscription continues until new Streaming TV is activated; billing for Streaming TV starts when you activate Sky Glass TV or Sky Stream puck. If you have Sky Q, you must send back Sky Q box(es) within 60 days of the Streaming TV cooling off period ending or you may incur a non‑returns charge. Recordings on Sky Q or Sky+ will not transfer to Sky Glass or Sky Stream puck. Sky Store Buy and Keep purchases remain accessible via Sky Store app. You will have to log in again to third‑party apps on Sky Glass/Stream.

rubrics_metrics.name: Device limits per account/household
rubrics_metrics.description: Maximum numbers of Sky Glass TVs and Sky Stream Pucks permitted per account/household.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maximum of 3 Sky Glass TVs and 6 Sky Stream Pucks per account/household. If you want to use both products together you need a Whole Home subscription and additional device requirements may apply.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sky Glass / Sky Stream delivery and signature requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Delivery is by courier with delivery options and signature requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose from Standard (£0) or Premium delivery (£45). Someone aged 18 or over must be home to sign for delivery. Order cut‑off times apply for next working day delivery (order by 9pm Mon–Fri or 3pm Sunday; excludes Bank Holidays). Returning Glass within the 31‑day cooling off period incurs a £25 fee added to your next bill.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sky Glass / Sky Stream streaming and broadband minimum speeds
rubrics_metrics.description: All content on Sky Glass and Sky Stream is streamed via broadband; minimum recommended speeds specified.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Minimum speed of 25 Mb/s recommended for Sky Glass and Sky Stream. Whole Home and certain add‑ons require higher minima (see respective entries). Additional bandwidth requirements apply per added device (e.g. additional 5 Mb/s per Sky Stream puck for Whole Home). Not all content available in UHD/HDR.

rubrics_metrics.name: Wall‑mount installation requirement for Sky Glass
rubrics_metrics.description: Installation requirements for wall mounting Sky Glass TV.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Both Sky Glass and Sky Stream puck can be self‑installed, but you must use a professional installer to wall mount Sky Glass.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maximum simultaneous streaming and device compatibility requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Hardware and compatibility requirements for Sky Stream and apps.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sky Stream requires a TV with an HDMI port. My Sky app and Sky Go require compatible devices and minimum streaming speeds (My Sky: Wi‑Fi/3G/4G/5G; Sky Go: min 2 Mb/s and registered compatible devices). App features vary by platform/device.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ultra HD and Dolby Atmos Pack requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Conditions to access Sky content in UHD/HDR and Dolby Atmos.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ultra HD and Dolby Atmos Pack costs £6pm extra on a 31‑day rolling subscription. Requires broadband min speed 30 Mb/s. Dolby Digital Plus must be enabled in Settings to experience Dolby Atmos sound. Not all content is available in UHD and/or HDR. 31 days’ notice to cancel. Offers may end (offers end 11/02/26 at time of page).

rubrics_metrics.name: Ad Skipping add‑on conditions
rubrics_metrics.description: Ad Skipping add‑on availability and limitations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ad Skipping costs £6pm on a 31‑day rolling subscription and allows fast‑forwarding through ads in on‑demand content including Sky and paid Entertainment VOD, ITVX, and Channel 4 apps; excludes Netflix. Cancel anytime; 31 days’ notice required to cancel. Requires Streaming TV subscription and Sky Glass or Sky Stream.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subscription pricing, minimum term and rolling options
rubrics_metrics.description: Different price points and minimum term commitments apply depending on new vs existing customers and package choices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: New Sky TV customers can take £15pm (with 24‑month minimum) or £18pm (31‑day rolling) for Essential TV; Ultimate TV pricing differs for new vs existing customers and auto‑renews at standard rolling price. Add‑ons (e.g., Sky Cinema, Sky Sports) often have 24‑month minimum terms to secure lower prices or 31‑day rolling options at higher standard prices. Prices may change during minimum terms and offers may apply. Cancellation and minimum term interactions (e.g., adding multiple subscriptions can create linked minimum terms) are specified per product.

rubrics_metrics.name: Add‑on conditional pricing interactions (Sky Cinema, Sky Sports, etc.)
rubrics_metrics.description: How taking or upgrading subscriptions/add‑ons affects pricing and minimum terms for other services.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you upgrade to Sky Cinema you may get Paramount+ Basic (with ads) at no extra cost for the duration of Sky Cinema. Taking multiple subscriptions with minimum terms can require keeping both for 24 months to maintain prices; adding/removing one can change other pricing and minimum terms. Specific examples given for Sky Sports, Sky Cinema, Paramount+, discovery+, TNT Sports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Guarantee — Speed Guarantee for Sky Broadband
rubrics_metrics.description: Right to leave without early termination charges if download speed to your hub falls below your guaranteed minimum for three consecutive days or more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applies anytime within your minimum term. Total loss of service and Major Service Outages do not count towards three‑day periods. Speed checks must be done using sky.com/servicechecker, the My Sky app or by speaking to a service advisor. See sky.com for more details, usage policies and to check speeds.

rubrics_metrics.name: WiFi Guarantee with Boost
rubrics_metrics.description: Guarantee available to new Ultrafast customers and as a re‑contract for existing customers with Sky Broadband Boost.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Minimum 3 Mb/s — Sky engineer's visit required to confirm WiFi speed — or money back and right to cancel Sky Broadband Boost without early termination charges. Money back is one month of broadband and Sky Broadband Boost credited to Sky account. Excludes Sky Talk and other add‑ons like McAfee. One claim per address, valid once during 24‑month minimum term. Claim only valid if using Sky router and booster(s). Not available with Sky Broadband Essential Plus. See sky.com/boostwifi.

rubrics_metrics.name: WiFi Max Guarantee
rubrics_metrics.description: Guarantee for customers using Sky fibre or NOW Powered by Sky fibre products and WiFi Max.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Different minimum speeds required depending on product (e.g., min 10 Mb/s for certain packages, min 25 Mb/s for Ultrafast/Full Fibre tiers). Sky engineer's visit required to confirm WiFi speed — or money back (one month credited) and you can cancel WiFi Max without early termination charges. Excludes external areas (gardens/sheds). One claim per address. Claim valid only if using Sky Max Hub and Sky Max Pod(s) and Device Priority is switched off. See sky.com/help/articles/enhanced-wall-to-wall-wifi-guarantee.

rubrics_metrics.name: Whole Home subscription requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements to watch Sky TV on multiple compatible devices in the home.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Whole Home costs £15pm extra on a 31‑day rolling subscription. Requires an additional Sky Glass TV or a Sky Stream puck (Set‑up £0 for first additional puck, £39.95 extra per puck thereafter), broadband min speed 30 Mb/s, compatible HDMI ports, and additional 5 Mb/s required for each Sky Stream puck added. You can also watch on other compatible devices via Sky Go.

rubrics_metrics.name: Promotional offers and vouchers (Vue Cinema Tickets) conditions
rubrics_metrics.description: Terms for promotional benefits such as Vue Cinema Tickets for Sky Cinema customers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Promotion available until 30 June 2027. Sky Cinema customers can claim up to two standard tickets per month, valid Sun–Thu. Not available to customers on a Sky Cinema trial offer, NOW Cinema members, or Virgin Media customers. Requires latest My Sky app. Voucher codes must be used within the same calendar month generated, expire otherwise. Codes cannot be combined and are valid for one ticket only. If you cancel Sky Cinema subscription, access to promotion ends when subscription ends. Daily limits apply; first come, first served.

rubrics_metrics.name: Paramount+ and discovery+ access terms and streaming requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Availability of discovery+ and Paramount+ with certain Sky packages and their streaming requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: discovery+ Entertainment included at no extra cost with some packages; minimum download speed 5 Mb/s and 20 Mb/s for 4K content. Separate account setup required; duplicate subscriptions possible. Paramount+ Standard available at £7.99 extra pm; streaming min speeds 2 Mb/s and 25 Mb/s for 4K UHD/HDR. Cancel anytime; specifics on auto‑switching between tiers when upgrading subscriptions provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sky hardware loan, returns, and set‑up fees
rubrics_metrics.description: Sky kit (routers, pucks, etc.) is loaned and must be returned; set‑up and activation fees may apply.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Any Sky kit is loaned at no cost and must be returned at the end of your broadband subscription. Set‑up fee of £9.95 router delivery plus £10 activation fee may be required. Non‑standard set‑up may cost extra. Failure to return hardware may incur charges (e.g., non‑returns charge for Sky Q boxes if not returned within specified window).

rubrics_metrics.name: Consumer credit and FCA regulation for device finance
rubrics_metrics.description: Terms for purchasing Sky Glass via loan/Consumer Credit Agreement (CCA).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Options to purchase Sky Glass Air/Gen 2 with a loan require an upfront fee (e.g., £20) and a Consumer Credit Agreement. Sky UK Limited is authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority (Reference Number 712293) for consumer credit. See sky.com/swaphelp for complete pricing and credit details.
